profile.headline: Software Developer at Charles Schwab
profile.summary: Currently working at Charles Schwab. I worked previously for General Motors as a Software Developer on the Strategic Digital In-source team to  develop a reporting solution that business requested to send out CSVs to specific business partners using API calls, Azure functions and SendGrid to show what kinds of assets have been downloaded, uploaded or published on a Digital Asset Management application. I worked on writing automation code for verifying our in-sourcing of an application. Started to work at General Motors as a Software Developer supporting the business of our Holden brand in Australia. My role with the Sales Order Management team moved more towards testing as my first year came to an end. I later on began working directly with testing as of November 2013 and got my title officially changed to Software Test Engineer on February 2014. I worked on the Vehicle Distribution Management project for our Brazilian business where I was writing and manually running test cases based off of the requirements from the business analysts until its release to production

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Writing code to create a reporting solution for our in-sourcing of a digital asset management application in C# (converted from Python). The script is running as an Azure function that would make multiple API calls to the DAM and build out a CSV that would be sent to business users.

Writing automation script in C# and Java for the test team on our Vehicle Distribution Management for their use that would the eliminate manual work especially after deployments. The automation script is written using an in-house common automation framework.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description: Doing / running manual tests. I write and run test cases from the requirements that I receive from the Business Analysts for our Vehicle Distribution Management project.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Using Java, I code and create selenium tests for defects on our order vehicle page for our Holden brand. Along with that, I work on the website with GUI improvements.

positions.title: OIT Help Desk Team Member
positions.description: Provided front line help desk support to SMU Faculty, Staff and Students offering assistance with wireless network connectivity, cell phone activations and configurations, password resets, email configuration and support, emergency classroom response and general troubleshooting of computer or software issues. Also support was provided primarily via walk up or online chat. All issues were logged via webform for reporting. Coordinated with the full time help desk and desktop personnel to ensure that all issues were resolved.
